questions.prompt: A skill's description says only "Release notes." What problem might this cause?
options: The skill body will be truncated
The skill tool will reject the name
The model may not realize when to load it, because the description does not say when it applies
The catalog will be too long for the context window
questions.explanation: The model sees only names and descriptions until it asks. A description that says what the skill does and when to use it is what makes the model load it at the right time.

questions.prompt: Twelve skills of about 3,000 tokens each are installed and the model loads one. Roughly how many skill tokens reach the model?
options: About 360 for the catalog plus 3,000 for the one loaded skill
Only 3,000, because the catalog is free
About 360, because bodies are never sent
questions.explanation: The catalog is about 30 tokens per skill, around 360. Only the requested body, about 3,000 tokens, arrives as a tool result.

questions.prompt: Why is the catalog recorded as a user message rather than added as a prompt section?
options: It keeps the system prompt identical across repositories, since each repository has different skills
User messages are hidden from the model
The skill tool can only read user messages
questions.explanation: The skills differ per repository. Recording the catalog as a message, like project instructions, keeps the system prompt unchanged so its beginning stays reusable.
